text:
noah: Quick thread: alternative to phase arrays: 'manifest overlay' stored in the shard-registry. bundles stay minimal; registry publishes small overlays for warmup + eviction tokens. idea is less bundle churn and centralized rollouts. thoughts?

emma: I like moving rollout control to a service. how do we ensure safety if the registry pushes a bad overlay? need signed overlays + a rollback token.

raj: signed overlays + short TTL sounds good. also need a safe-apply semantics: manifest_overlay has three ops: pin, deprioritize, unpin. loader should apply idempotently.

zara: loader API idea: apply_overlay(overlay_id, mode="dry-run|apply|apply-with-grace"). grace mode would stagger IO to avoid spikes.

noah: exactly. grace mode = apply but respect a rate limit and coalesce adjacent shard reads. also overlays carry an "eviction_token" so we can later revoke warmup effects if rollout fails.

emma: canary story: registry will compute overlays per-az. overlay includes target_azs and rollout_rate. loader enforces target_azs. perfect for gradual rollouts.

raj: we need offline verification: perf-sim should be able to ingest overlay and predict mem/latency delta before applying. add an overlay_score computed from historical hotness.

zara: operational metrics: overlay_apply_time, overlay_revoke_time, percent_requests_served_by_overlay, overlay_fallback_rate. alert if revoke happens >3 times in 24h.

noah: security: overlay payload signed by KMS key; includes manifest_version and overlay_uuid. loader rejects overlays with mismatched manifest_version.

emma: failure modes: registry unreachable -> loader falls back to embedded fallback hints in bundle (tiny hot-list). older loaders without overlay support ignore overlays. need graceful compatibility.

raj: implementation sequence: 1) registry API + signing 2) loader subscribe+dry-run apply 3) perf-sim integration 4) gradual canary gating.

zara: dev-bot: can you run a perf-sim for overlay=hot-100-topshards on staging bundle and post results?

dev-bot: perf-sim queued (id=overlay-ps-421314). will post when complete.

noah: will draft registry proto and an example overlay schema. keeping overlays minimal: list of shard_uuids + ops + priorities + rollout hints.

emma: add a small audit-entry field so overlays are human-auditable (who/why). keep it optional but searchable.

raj: also add a compatibility test that simulates overlay revoke and measures tail behavior. we dont want revokes to cause OOM or catastrophic tail spikes.

zara: good point. if revoke leads to eviction storms we need a staggered eviction primitive too. overlay can include 'revoke_grace_ms' to control that.

noah: great feedback. I'll open a staging RFC PR with the overlay proto and loader API sketch. thanks all.
